Gujarat schools to restrict outsider entry, protect student data

The Gujarat Education Department has directed all schools to implement stricter entry rules, preventing outsiders from entering school premises without prior permission. Additionally, schools are prohibited from collecting, publishing, or circulating students' photographs, videos, and personal information.
